text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 5xx rate observed from gateway -> upstream (service: streaming-gateway). 5m error-rate 6.9% (threshold 1%). Alerting P1. Alert link: <https://pager/redwood/INC-679|INC-679>

alex: i'm oncall, paging infra and eng-sre. starting triage. any customer-visible timeouts/500s reported? :rotating_light:

maria: seeing lots of gateway 504 and 502 in nginx logs. problem looks like request timeouts upstream. big signal: lots of requests without x-request-id header so traces are missing.

jonathan: confirming. traces not showing spans for many requests; sampling is fine but no request_id propagation. that's an instrumentation gap.

alex: okay — plan: 1) route around overloaded app instances via canary fallback to model-variant B, 2) enable verbose ingress logging to capture raw headers, 3) increase trace sampling temporarily and add stopgap request-id injection at LB sidecar. who can patch ingress config?

claire: i can cut the ingress restart patch. prepping a small hotpatch to add x-request-id header if missing.

maria: heads up — we don't have an existing sidecar that injects request-id for these routes. quick option: nginx lua snippet to set header if absent, then reload.

claire: patch (applying now):
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/gateway INGRESS_EXTRA_LUA='if ngx.var.http_x_request_id == nil then ngx.req.set_header("x-request-id", ngx.var.request_id or tostring(ngx.now())) end'
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/gateway
```

alex: rolling. alerting CS to prep messages. @support any customers currently impacted?

support-bot: 2 active sessions with latency >5s, 1 client error spike recorded (enterprise-corp). Ticket #TCK-421 opened.

jonathan: i'm bumping trace sampling to 100% for gateway for next 30m:
```
# feature flag toggle
curl -XPOST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' https://flags.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"gateway_trace_sample", "value":true}'
```

maria: increased logging is showing x-request-id now for new requests. we can correlate traces for future requests. historical requests still missing.

alex: mitigation status: 1) ingress sidecar header injection applied and stable, 2) trace sampling increased, 3) traffic routed away from 2 unhealthy nodes. error-rate down to 1.3% in 10m.

claire: adding a short-term log collector config to push request headers to central logs so SREs can search quickly.

support-bot: sent customer notice draft to #customer-success for review. no major outages, degraded errors for some sessions.

alex: thanks team. leaving a followup to make request-id propagation permanent and add test coverage. handing off to eng-sre for post-incident instrumentation runbook.

maria: taking postmortem ownership. will include checklist: ensure x-request-id propagation, integration test to assert trace-log correlation, and add alert for missing request-id rate >1%.

alex: handoff to maria. i'm offcall in 20m. ping in thread if anything regresses. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Error-rate reduced to baseline. P1 -> P2. Monitoring for 2h. Link: <https://incidents/reports/INC-679>
